The '''Infinite Nebstar Casino''' was a large [[Casino/Legends|casino]] that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tarko-se/Legends|Tarko-se]]. [[Gambling/Legends|Gamblers]] could bet on events at the [[Tarko-se Arena]]. It had a buffet table which was known to serve spiced [[Mynock/Legends|mynock]] wings. It was protected by the [[Second Floor Security]].
